title: Late Charge Rates for Michigan and Pennsylvania Communities — Home Purchase Financing
content:
**State-by-community rate schedule — Home Purchase Financing late charges**

The late charge rate — the percentage of the monthly principal-and-interest amount on which a late charge is figured — is chosen by the community the home's site lies in: in Conestoga Meadows it is 2.0 percent, and in Cedar Hollow it is 4.0 percent. For a site in any other community this schedule sets no community rate.

The community is the one shown on the borrower's Home-Site Lease for the financed home's site.

| Community of the home's site (from the Home-Site Lease) | Late charge rate |
|---|---|
| Conestoga Meadows (Pennsylvania) | 2.0 percent |
| Cedar Hollow (Michigan) | 4.0 percent |
| any other community | not set by this schedule |

*Hypothetical figures.* On a monthly principal and interest of 900.00, a 2.0 percent rate gives 18.00 before rounding and bounds; a 4.0 percent rate gives 36.00.
